name: How do general contractors typically charge for their services?

mainEntity.name: How do general contractors typically charge for their services?

acceptedAnswer.text: General contractors typically charge for their services using one of several methods: a fixed-price contract, a cost-plus contract, or a time-and-materials contract. A fixed-price contract offers a single, all-inclusive price for the entire project. A cost-plus contract involves the client paying for actual project costs plus a pre-agreed percentage or fixed fee for the contractor's overhead and profit. Time-and-materials contracts are common for smaller projects where costs are less predictable, billing for hours worked and materials used. The best method depends on the project's scope and client preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: General contractors typically charge via fixed-price, cost-plus, or time-and-materials contracts. The method chosen depends on the project's scope and client agreement.
